title: The target is on the screen.
summary: The integrity panel gives the required timing only in the running game. The agent reads it, repairs the engine, checks the fix live and catches a bug in its own first edit.
end_note: The panel went offline before a final live check, as the agent reports. The independent verifier checked the submitted patch.

stages.title: Reproduce in the running game
stages.insight: The panel reports TIMING MISMATCH against a 1.6 s target shown only in the interface.

stages.title: Locate the fault in source
stages.insight: Loss is hard-coded to 3.2 s, and reset never cancels the pending callback.

stages.title: Make the first repair
stages.insight: A 1.6 s delay, cancellation on reset and an episode token. Syntax checks pass; no build script exists.

stages.title: Check the repair live
stages.insight: The live pass exposes a bug in the first edit: a local e shadows the browser global.

stages.title: Correct and submit
stages.insight: The scheduler now uses window.setTimeout. The protected verifier passes all 10 checks.
